notes.title: The Demo Is Here! Let’s Fight.
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]Big news — the [i]Street Fight Club Simulator[/i] demo is now LIVE![/p][p]This is just the beginning, but we’ve poured our hearts into it and can’t wait to hear what you think.
You’ll get a taste of the underground scene, meet some shady characters, and (hopefully) survive your first two days.[/p][p]We’re still a small team, building this game with passion and sleepless nights — so every bit of feedback matters.
If you enjoy the demo, please consider wishlisting the game — it truly helps more than you know.[/p][p]Thanks for being here with us.[/p][p][/p][p]-Team Alice[/p]

notes.title: Demo’s Almost Here! 🥊
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]We’ve got something exciting on the way —
our very first [i]playable demo[/i] is coming [b]soon[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]It’s not quite ready yet, but we’re polishing the last bits and can’t wait to share it with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for all the wishlists, kind words, and support.

notes.title: Hey there! Just a small team chasing a big dream.
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Writing this here has been a dream for a long time.[/p][p][/p][p]When we started working on this game, all we had was an idea and a lot of excitement. Now, after months of hard work as a small team, things are finally starting to take shape.[/p][p][/p][p]The Steam page is live, the trailer is out, and we’re getting ready to share the very first playable demo with you soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Every single comment, wishlist addition, and “this looks cool” message means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p][b]This is not just a game — it’s a dream we’ve poured our hearts into.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’ll enjoy playing it as much as we’ve enjoyed creating it.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for following, supporting, and being curious about our little project.[/p][p]We’ll be here with more updates soon.[/p][p][/p][p]With love,[/p][p]
— Alice Games[/p]
